description: Service layer for managing notes, encapsulating business logic for creating, updating, fetching, listing, and deleting notes in a notes application.

classes.name: NoteService
classes.description: Service component responsible for business logic related to Note entities, providing methods to create, retrieve, update, list, and delete notes.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new note from a NoteRequest DTO, saves it via the repository, and returns a NoteResponse.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by id with data from NoteRequest, and returns the updated NoteResponse.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches a note by id and converts it into a NoteResponse.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated, sorted list of notes, optionally filtered by archived status and a search query.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by id if it exists.

methods.name: parseSort
methods.description: Parses the sort parameter string into a Spring Sort object.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Converts a Note entity to a NoteResponse DTO.
